add_densepose_config: add all DensePose configuration options including head, HRNet, bootstrap, dataset category, and evaluation settings to a Detectron2 CfgNode
add_densepose_head_config: add DensePose head configuration options for ROI-based dense pose estimation including predictor, loss, and decoder settings
add_densepose_head_cse_config: add Continuous Surface Embeddings configuration options for embedding size, loss weights, and cycle consistency loss parameters
add_hrnet_config: add HRNet backbone configuration options including stage modules, branches, channels, and HRFPN output channels
load_bootstrap_config: load and convert bootstrap dataset entries from dicts into CfgNode format that comply with the bootstrap specification
